## Summary

Describe the user-visible or research-engineering problem and the change that addresses it.

## Boundary affected

- [ ] Source/provider acquisition
- [ ] Contracts or persistence
- [ ] Ranking/policy/explanations
- [ ] Private UI/API
- [ ] Deployment/identity/secrets
- [ ] Documentation only

## Validation

List the commands, tests, fixtures, or manual checks run.

## Privacy and provenance

- [ ] No credentials, private archives, personal history, or deployment-only state are included.
- [ ] New transformed data retains appropriate provenance.
- [ ] Behavior-changing documentation has been updated.
